title: Re-Test Hours Billed on Work Conditioning and Work Hardening Program Days
content:
# Re-test hours billed on a program day

*Billing manual note — Workers' Compensation Referral, Work Conditioning Program and Work Hardening Program.*

The program hours billed for a program day are divided into re-test hours and conditioning hours. The billed re-test hours are two (2) where at least twice the program's progress-report interval has passed since the latest progress report sent to the adjuster (or since the evaluation date of service where none has been sent), one (1) where at least one interval but less than two has passed, and none otherwise, and never more than the program hours recorded for the day.

The evaluation date of service is the date of service of the referral's evaluation charge; time is counted in calendar days.

## Progress-report interval by program

| Program | Interval | One interval at | Two intervals at |
|---|---|---|---|
| Work Conditioning Program | 14 calendar days | 14 days | 28 days |
| Work Hardening Program | 7 calendar days | 7 days | 14 days |

## Bands

| Calendar days since the latest progress report (or the evaluation date of service) | Billed re-test hours |
|---|---|
| fewer than one interval | none |
| at least one, fewer than two intervals | 1 |
| two intervals or more | 2 |

The band result is then held to the program hours recorded for the day: a day recorded at 1 hour carries at most 1 billed re-test hour, and a day recorded at 0 hours carries none.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Program | Days since latest progress report | Program hours recorded for the day | Billed re-test hours |
|---|---|---|---|
| Work Hardening Program | 15 | 6 | 2 |
| Work Hardening Program | 9 | 6 | 1 |
| Work Conditioning Program | 10 | 3 | none |
| Work Conditioning Program | 30 | 1 | 1 — held to the hours recorded |
